title: Junk Removal Invoice Template
subtitle: An invoice pre-filled for junk removal jobs — full or half truckload, furniture, appliances, labor and disposal. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Payment due at time of service unless prior credit terms are agreed.
notes: Thank you for your business. Weight and volume confirmed at pickup; final total reflects actual load.
features: Auto-calculating tax formulas in Excel (just enter your state rate)
Pre-filled junk removal line items: truckload, furniture, appliances, labor, disposal
Pickup-address field — junk jobs often bill the pickup site, not the client address
Pay-at-service terms keep every load settled before the truck leaves

faqs.q: What should I include on a junk removal invoice?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name, the client and pickup address, a dated line-item list (truckload, furniture, appliances, labor, disposal fee), tax, and a total due. Confirm weight and volume at pickup so the final total matches the load.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate tax automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, tax and total update automatically. Leave the tax rate blank if you are not required to charge sales tax.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your tax authority and a CPA or attorney before use.
